notes.title: Version 2.0.2 has been released!
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed:

- Some important items were lost in Heaven’s Door
- Names of “Oil Slime” and “Nitro Buddy” were flipped. 
- Not be able to do perfect clear at certain floor in Grabi Desert.
- Adjusted score balance in some dungeons.

We hope you are enjoying the game and the new updates! Please [url=https://bit.ly/OnionGamesDiscord]join us in our Discord[/url] to discuss the game or to let us know in the #support channel if you have any additional issues!

notes.title: Version 2.0.1 has been released!
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed:

- When using certain languages or regions, the game would be stuck on the title screen.
- The game occasionally hanging when connecting to the leaderboard.
- Some enemies received AI adjustments. 
- Some texts were not properly displayed at Tabata and Nishinippori stations.
- Other small bugs!

We hope you are enjoying the game and the new updates! Please [url=https://bit.ly/OnionGamesDiscord]join us in our Discord[/url] to discuss the game or to let us know in the #support channel if you have any additional issues!

notes.title: Version 1.1.6 has been released!
notes.notes:
The following bug has been fixed:
-Leaderboards not appearing.

For all our players on Mac:

Due to a bug with our leaderboards, Mac players must change the location of their save data, or the data will not load and the game will start again from the beginning.

If you'd like to manually move your save data and avoid this, please follow the steps below:

1.) Display your Mac's hidden folders by pressing [command] + [shift] + [.] in Finder.

2.) Find your old savedata in the folder below: /Users/YOUR_USER_NAME/Library/Containers/jp.oniongames.dandydungeon/Data/Library/Application Support/jp.oniongames.dandydungeon

3.) Copy and paste the savedata.dat into the folder below:
/Users/YOUR_USER_NAME/Library/Application Support/DMM/DandyDungeon

4.) Hide your hidden folders again by pressing [command] + [shift] + [.] in Finder.

* PLEASE NOTE! * Making any other changes to your hidden folders can cause unexpected issues, so please be careful following the steps above!

Want to report new bugs? Find our support thread here to help us track down any problems: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1138970/discussions/0/1743386672809011770/

You can also find us in our Discord channel, right over here: https://discord.gg/Uhc5pQK

Thanks to all our players for helping us make our games the best they can be!
